The '''Imperial Collection Agency''' was branch of the [[Imperial Treasury]] that was responsible for collecting revenues for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] through fines and taxes. They were headquartered on the [[City/Legends|city]]-[[Ecumenopolis/Legends|spanning]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is unknown what relationship this agency has with the [[Imperial Taxation Bureau]], mentioned elsewhere.
